sources.title: Female singer 1 — recorded breathy final C4 vowel
sources.referencePolicy: Manual C4 note label supported by stable-region autocorrelation; native final note retained. Actual breathiness comes from the recorded technique, not filtering or generated noise.
sources.attribution: VocalSet: A Singing Voice Dataset — Julia Wilkins, Prem Seetharaman, Alison Wahl, Bryan Pardo (2018), CC BY 4.0.
modificationOrder: constant gain to -3 dBFS sample peak
sources.modifications: Selected the final nonlinguistic /a/ note from a real recorded breathy arpeggio after its preceding pitch transition. An explicit 80 ms half-cosine entrance fade smooths the mid-vowel crop, followed by constant gain to -3 dBFS sample peak. The natural vocal release and quiet ending remain intact; no exit fade, EQ, noise generation, denoising, pitch shift, or time stretch. Complete original WAV retained.
sources.selectionBasis: Original5.95–7.15s: preceding E4 transition resolves to C4 by5.95s; stable native C4 body around6.10–6.65s; natural recorded release around6.85–7.00s and quiet margin through7.15s. Full selected tail and sustain pitch trajectory inspected. Dataset technique is explicitly breathy; no perceptual owner acceptance claimed.

sources.title: Female singer 1 — complete recorded breathy arpeggio
sources.referencePolicy: Manual initial C4 reference supported by autocorrelation; preserve the complete native C4–C5–C4 arpeggio contour. Do not flatten this source to a held note.
sources.attribution: VocalSet: A Singing Voice Dataset — Julia Wilkins, Prem Seetharaman, Alison Wahl, Bryan Pardo (2018), CC BY 4.0.
modificationOrder: crop with natural entrance and release margins
constant gain to -3 dBFS sample peak
sources.modifications: Retained the complete recorded breathy arpeggio with its naturally quiet entrance, full native melodic contour, natural release, and quiet ending. Only source crop and constant -3 dBFS peak normalization were applied. No fades, stretching, repeated excerpt, EQ, generated breath/noise, denoising, or pitch shift. Full original recording and earlier short final-vowel proof retained.
sources.selectionBasis: Original0.20–7.40s contains the whole single /a/ arpeggio: initial native C4 gesture from around0.5s, ascending to C5 and returning to C4, then natural voiced release around6.85–7.00s followed by quiet room tone. No adjacent gesture occurs within the original recording. Dataset explicitly labels the technique breathy; perceptual listening approval remains open.

pitchObservation.region: Marked initial C4 only; the complete phrase intentionally moves through other notes.

sources.nativeContourDescription: Complete native C4–C5–C4 vowel arpeggio; duration comes from the recording.

tailBoundaryGuard.policy: Fixture-specific amplitude-only quiet-ending check for a complete melodic phrase; pitch is intentionally not constrained to a flat vowel.
